sections.heading: Purpose and lot identification
body: This letter requests deforestation-free and legality evidence for the lots listed below for use in internal due diligence.

sections.heading: Geolocation data requested
body: Provide plot coordinates as points or polygons with the reference system stated, plus a table linking plot identifiers to harvest dates and volumes.

sections.heading: Legality documents requested
body: Provide the permits, titles, licences, and chain-of-custody records agreed for this origin, with issuer and date for each document.

sections.heading: Accuracy declaration
body: The supplier confirms the data relates to the stated lots and will notify us promptly of corrections.

sections.heading: Lot summary
body: Record product, quantity, origin, and statement status for the lot being closed.

sections.heading: Evidence status
body: List complete items, missing items, and compensating evidence with file references.

sections.heading: Risk conclusion and follow-up
body: Record the risk conclusion, approver function, and assigned follow-up with dates.

sections.heading: Product and code analysis
body: Record the declaration code, commodity mapping, and scope decision with reasons.

sections.heading: Review and re-verification
body: Record reviewer function, counsel input where sought, and the next re-verification date.
